name: villa-sonnet
summary: Single-storey Pompeian domus, 36x48, mirror-symmetric about x=17.5 on a podium (floor y1, rooms y2..5). Street front has a recessed fauces between four shuttered shops. Behind it come the atrium with a compluvium and impluvium, the tablinum on the same axis, and a 18-column white peristyle around a fountain garden. Sixteen red-tile roof pieces slope inward to the courts (ridges ≤ y9), and the work splits into six parts: shell, roofs, street, atrium, peristyle, finish. (25 of 25 parts finished)
